title_sq: Tek Kompleksi Tower Bridge, Shitet Dyqan Me Fasade Xhami Ideal Per Investim !!!
description_sq: Tek Kompleksi Tower Bridge, Shitet Dyqan Me Fasade Xhami Per Aktivitete Te Ndryshme Tregtare!!! Ambienti Tregtar ndodhet ne katin e 1, te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit, ku 2 katet e para jane te destinuara per biznes. Ka siperfaqe 38.5m² dhe strukturohet si openspace. Mund te shfrytezohet per nje sere aktivitetesh tregtare dhe ka mundesi brandimi ne fasade. Aktualisht eshte i lene me qira ne vleren 300 euro/muaj neto. Prona disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: At the Tower Bridge Complex, a shop with a glass facade is for sale, ideal for investment!!!
description_en: At Tower Bridge Complex, Shop With Glass Facade For Various Commercial Activities!!! The commercial environment is located on the 1st floor of one of the buildings of the complex, where the first 2 floors are intended for business. It has a surface of 38.5 m² and is structured as an open space. It can be used for a variety of commercial activities and there is a possibility of branding on the facade. It is currently rented for 300 euros/month net. The property has full mortgage documentation.
